title: Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Rideshare Daily Allowance Rate Card
content:
**Daily rideshare allowance.** For rideshare, taxi and transit under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, the daily rideshare allowance depends on two things: the length of the stint, and the option's daily limit.

The length of the stint is the number of covered rideshare days. These are counted from the first covered rideshare day through the last covered rideshare day, both included, and are never fewer than zero.

| Option's daily limit | 2 or fewer covered rideshare days | More than 2 covered rideshare days |
|---|---|---|
| $50.00 or more | $45.00 | $35.00 |
| Below $50.00 | The option's daily limit | The option's daily limit |

## By option

| Option | Daily limit | Allowance, 2 days or fewer | Allowance, 3 days or more |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 30/900 | $30.00 | $30.00 | $30.00 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 40/1200 | $40.00 | $40.00 | $40.00 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 50/1500 | $50.00 | $45.00 | $35.00 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 60/1800 | $60.00 | $45.00 | $35.00 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 75/2250 | $75.00 | $45.00 | $35.00 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 100/3000 | $100.00 | $45.00 | $35.00 |

## Boundaries

- **Stint length.** 2 covered days is a short stint and takes $45.00. 3 covered days is a long stint and takes $35.00, on an option with a daily limit of $50.00 or more.
- **Daily limit.** An option whose daily limit is exactly $50.00, which is Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 50/1500, is on the $45.00 / $35.00 rows.
